text.title: Rabbit
text.intro_safe: Safe mode: explore! Find clover, dig a burrow, meet the foxes.
text.intro_survival: Keep your food and warmth up. Sleep in a burrow at night.
text.intro_wild: Foxes hunt rabbits. Stay near cover and run!
text.night_hint: It's night. Dig a burrow into a hillside and sleep in it.
text.too_exposed: Too exposed to sleep! Dig a burrow into a hillside and sleep in it.
text.hungry: You're hungry. Look for clover (pink flowers) and wild carrots.
text.no_food: Nothing to eat here. Look for clover (pink flowers) and wild carrots.
text.dig: Digging... (a burrow keeps you safe and warm)
text.rain_start: It's starting to rain. Shelter in a burrow to stay warm.
text.chased: A fox is chasing you! Run, or hide in a burrow!
text.stalk_hint: A rabbit! Creep up slowly (don't run), then tap Pounce.
text.about_looks: Grey-brown fur, long ears and a fluffy white tail that flashes when it runs.
text.about_food: Grass, clover and herbs. In winter, bark, twigs and buds.
text.about_home: Lives in a warren: a network of tunnels it digs together with other rabbits.
text.about_winter: Stays active. In hard frost and storms it stays underground.
text.about_young: Babies are born blind and without fur, in a nest the mother lines with her own fur. She can have several litters a year.
text.about_fact: In Finland, wild rabbits live only in towns and parks. The forest's own hare is the mountain hare, which turns white in winter.

year.shelter: Lives in a warren: a network of burrows it digs into a sandy bank. Stays underground in hard frost and storms.
year.young: Several litters from March to September, born blind in a fur-lined nest chamber.

food.winter: Bark, twigs, buds and dry grass dug out from under the snow.

year.notes: In Finland, rabbits live wild only in towns; the native forest species is the mountain hare, which turns white in winter.
